programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Drovers Run is cleared out by thieves while Jodi and Craig take advantage of everybody else's absence from the ranch to enjoy a secret rendezvous in the spa.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire and Alex's potential clients are being put off by rumours circulated by Peter that, ten years ago, Alex was responsible for crippling a boy, Stefan Van Amstel when he deliberately ran his car off the road.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess meets Sandra Kinsela at the cattle sale yards and likes her instantly, only to discover Claire dislikes her intensely. Their childhood dispute is renewed when a herd of calves is stolen from Drovers Run and Claire is convinced that Sandra is responsible.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess is on the brink of committing to Nick but she is struggling with the intensity of her feelings for him. Meanwhile, Jodi and Alberto are forced to move back to Drovers Run when they are kicked out of their apartment in town after being unable to pay the rent.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: On the eve of the Gungellan Show, Claire is presented with repossession papers for Drovers Run. Nick and Tess become estranged after Tess walked out on him, but she tries to explain her actions of the previous night.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Peter offers to stop the repossession of Drovers Run if Claire marries him, but she rejects his proposal. She is injured in a fall during the Stockman's Challenge and the accident reveals her pregnancy. In order to help Claire, Alex steps forward to claim paternity.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire returns to Drovers Run after her stay in the hospital, but she must deal with the lie she told that Alex is the father of her child when he isn't.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is busy making plans for a huge wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances. When Alberto informs Jodi that her mother is intending to sell her jewels to pay for the event; Jodi decides a simple, traditional wedding may be better.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess believes Sally is cheating on Nick when she sees her in town with another man. Jodi's wedding plans go down the drain when Alberto learns about the affair she had while overseas, and Jake tries to help Becky cope with her feelings following Brett's death.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: As a pre-Bucks Night prank, Craig and a couple of his mates kidnap Alberto and leave him in the middle of nowhere. When Jodi finds out, she goes ballistic and searches for Alberto with Craig.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly, which creates tensions in the family.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky senses the mystery surrounding Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves. Sally accidentally leaves a gate open and a herd of sheep damages Tess and Nick's wheat crop.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary is shattered when Harry's nagging suspicions about Alex not being the father of Claire's baby explodes into a fit of rage after an innocent remark leads to Liz confessing a long-held secret.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Relations between Alex and his father take another turn for the worse when Alex discovers he has been cut off financially. Nick tries to play peacemaker but both sides are stubborn and his efforts go unappreciated.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run to write a feature magazine article about life on the land. However, tensions between her and Tess begin to rise as old wounds are reopened and long-forgotten feelings are revisited.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions. Jodi discovers the real reason Kylie left home when she goes through Kylie's mail. A pending court date for a shoplifting charge is rapidly approaching but Kylie seems willing to ignore it.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex, especially when Sandra Kinsella appears on the scene.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend while they argue over Harry's proposal for a stock route through Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Tess stubbornly refuses to ask for outside help to shear her alpacas, insisting on doing the job herself.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen by Claire and Tess over Drovers Run. Tess is determined to believe they are a good omen, but Claire, restless and uneasy in the last stages of pregnancy, insists that trouble awaits.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter. The chaotic situation is just one more stress for Claire who is struggling to balance the demands of motherhood with that of running the ranch.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire is having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends and family when Peter arrives. Claire has written to him after the birth, telling him he is a father. Peter is justifiably angry.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Determined to prove herself during a Fire Service training weekend, Jodi quickly realises it's going to be far more difficult than she had anticipated. Meanwhile, Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in 'Pride and Prejudice'.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex and Nick come to the rescue of an attractive woman named Ellie when her car breaks down on a country road. Almost instantly they're pitched into a competition to woo her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Drovers Run is quarantined and the future of the stock placed under a cloud, true friends seem few and far between as Claire finally goes head-to-head with her old enemy Sandra Kinsella. Meg and Terry have their eye on a piece of land but are unable to come up with the deposit, until an offer of help comes from an unlikely person.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire's role as spokesperson for the local farmers' association requires her to visit Melbourne. Alex is insistent that he come along to look after them while also pursuing some Wilgul matters, but the real reason is that he wants to meet his biological father.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire and Alex are still in Melbourne, blissfully in love. At Drovers, Tess and Dave are making plans for their wedding day. When Tess, in the shower, discovers a lump in her breast, she fears she will share her mother's fate and quickly goes into denial, telling no-one.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess and Dave split up when they realise that he has not yet come to terms with the death of his wife. Meanwhile, prompted by Becky, Claire asks Harry if she can use King Harold in a new breeding program on Drovers.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess's upcoming operation has thoughts of mortality creeping in, so she begins to write a letter to Charlotte so that her niece can know her, should Tess no longer be around. Meanwhile, Claire reminisces when an old friend turns up unexpectedly.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Heartbreak hits Drovers Run. Tess anxiously awaits the results of her breast cancer tests, convinced that her time is up, while Alex and Claire decide to move in together.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way. Tess tries to keep her emotions in check, unable to deal with her grief and burdened by survivor's guilt. Terry, Jodi, and Meg are left with the task of running Drovers Run and dealing with funeral arrangements.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come to the surface when a private investigator turns up. Tess accepts Stevie's explanations at first but gets suspicious when Stevie is caught packing her bags.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her for not pressing charges for stealing her plane. To get out of Sandra's scheme, Tess takes a big gamble, confident she can defeat Sandra in a winner takes all poker game.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess is surprised in the middle of the night by a stranger named Jack Blake who knocks at the door looking for Jack McLeod... his father. Tess's mind is spinning with the possibility of a new member of the family - something she is lacking after Claire's death.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Brad Whittaker, the new Stock, and Station agent make a good first impression on the women of Drovers Run, but things quickly go downhill from there. Sandra has a surprising solution when Alex and Nick face a heart-wrenching decision

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion Ken Logan occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol. When Ken later collapses at work, he leaves Stevie with a cryptic message, believing she is his estranged daughter.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

One night, Paul and his best friend, Sal (Kevin Corrigan), spy Giants linebacker Quantrell Bishop in their neighborhood and follow him to a strip club. Paul decides to approach his idol, but the encounter goes very badly.

programme.title: Basquiat
programme.desc: Despite living a life of extreme poverty in Brooklyn, graffiti artist Jean-Michel Basquiat (Jeffrey Wright) strives to rise up through the heady New York art scene of the 1970s and 1980s. He becomes the brightest star of neo-Expressionist painting and one of the most successful painters of his time, and even develops a friendship with Andy Warhol (David Bowie). But Basquiat's tumultuous life, specifically his addiction to heroin, overshadows his rise to fame, threatening all.

programme.title: The Long Riders

programme.title: Tom Horn

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: In the early days of the Christian faith, there is no church; no single institution to guide the followers of Jesus; stepping into the world of the early church; the roots of Christianity as found in ancient Jewish traditions and the gospel.
programme.sub-title: From Jesus to the Creation of the Church

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: In the first century A.D., the followers of Christ evolve from a band of disciples into tight-knit communities of worship; a glimpse of these communities in some of the earliest Christian documents; the Acts of the Apostles and the letters of Paul.

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: Christianity quickly spreads all over the Mediterranean region in the first few centuries; learning how believers adapt the practice of their faith to create a great diversity of worship in the early church.

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: The Christian church catches the attention of the Roman emperor; he views the faithful as a threat to imperial authority and Roman culture; the widespread persecution of Christians that follows; a new class of Christian heroes, the martyred saints.

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: In 312 A.D., Christianity gains a powerful ally when the Roman emperor Constantine adopts the faith of Jesus as his own; seeing how this shift affects Christian believers; the church goes from being a persecuted minority to a privileged minority.

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: Entering the world of biblical Israel with a historical overview; an examination of how the Bible gives insights into the daily life of ancient Israelites; considering the context for how the Bible comes into being.
programme.sub-title: Biblical Israel - The Story of a People

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: A look at the Babylonian exile; the exiled Judeans begin asking themselves who they are as a people and why they are conquered; as the Bible begins to be compiled in this time of exile, it offers two vantage points for understanding its history.
programme.sub-title: By the Rivers of Babylon - Exile

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: Surveying the stories of ancient Israel's origins as preserved in the book of Genesis; these origin stories are crucial for understanding the books that follow because ancient Israel understands itself to be a family that descends from Jacob.

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: A look at Moses; the story of the Israelites' exodus from Egypt; tracing the narrative of Moses's journey, which includes receiving the Ten Commandments from Yahweh; reviewing the Torah, the "law of Moses"; the origins of the priesthood.

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: The emergence of Israel as a nation, which is detailed in the books of Joshua and Judges; what the books say about the Israelites' conquest of Canaan; what archeological evidence shows about this period; biblical archeology's origins and methods.

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: Surveying the topography and layout of Jerusalem; reviewing biblical accounts of Jerusalem from the arrival of David around 1,000 B.C.E. to the start of the Babylonian exile in 586 B.C.E.; the remains of an Assyrian siege on the city of Lachish.
programme.sub-title: Jerusalem - An Introduction to the City

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: A first look at the biblical City of David; combing through the remains of a scribe's house behind a city wall; the development of biblical Hebrew script; rare examples of this script in a clay sealing, a piece of pottery and a victory stele.
programme.sub-title: The Jerusalem of David and Solomon

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: The City of David's ancient water system centered on the Gihon Spring; the three different water systems that are created due to the spring's location outside the city walls; these include Warren's Shaft, Siloam Channel and Hezekiah's Tunnel.

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: Learning about Israel as it is ruled under the Omride dynasty between Solomon's death and the Assyrian invasion in 722 B.C.E.; exploring ruins such as the High Place at Dan; the acropolis at Samaria, which holds the remains of King Ahab's palace.
programme.sub-title: Samaria and the Northern Kingdom of Israel

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The opening lecture presents the main themes of the course; beginning with the concept of total war; other themes include the role of ideology, the meanings ascribed to the war by different sides and the war's legacy.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: Examining the state of Europe and the world before the onset of the war in 1914; the emergence of the German Empire creates strains in the international balance of power; divided among Great Britain, France, Germany, Austria-Hungary and Russia.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: Even among those who expect war, there are widespread misconceptions about the nature of the conflict to come; in this lecture, exploring the prevailing ideas and attitudes in Europe; the premonitions noted by contemporaries of coming disaster.
programme.sub-title: Towards Crisis in Politics and Culture

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: This lecture analyzes the immediate events that lead to war; the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary at Sarajevo in June 1914; the diplomatic chain reactions that follow in the July Crisis.
programme.sub-title: Causes of the War and the July Crisis, 1914

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The hysterical celebration known as the August Madness greets the outbreak of war between the Central Powers (Germany and Austria-Hungary) and the Allies (France, Great Britain and Russia); how widespread this emotional outburst really is.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: This lecture follows the unfolding of the German Schlieffen Plan, which envisions quick victory on two fronts; the French Plan XVII aims to recover lost French territories; both attempts are thwarted.
programme.sub-title: The Failed Gambles - War Plans Break Down

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The Western Front soon freezes into static trench warfare and horrific slaughter from attempts to break this deadlock; generals on both sides seek a breakthrough that allows sweeping offensives and glorious cavalry charges; these never materialize.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: A detailed overview of the trench landscape from the perspective of ordinary soldiers; the elaborate fortifications; the omnipresence of death; the codes of behavior such as the Christmas fraternizations between the trenches in 1914.
programme.sub-title: Life and Death in the Trenches

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The horrors of Nazi Germany are one hallmark of World War II; pondering how ordinary German citizens find themselves participating in such heinous events; going inside the propaganda machine of Hitler's Germany; seeing how it targets the youth.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The origins of World War II lie in Asia in 1931; tracing the invasion of 1937 and the Rape of Nanjing; witnessing the events through the eyes of a Chinese soldier and a Japanese journalist, young men who bear witness to the flesh and blood of battle.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: In addition to the story of people, World War II is the story of technology; perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than the tanks Germany uses to barrel across Poland and France in "lightning warfare"; how new technology defeats the old ways of war.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Wartime Warsaw offers a gateway to the darkest events of the war; bearing witness as the city's Jews are rounded up and put in the ghetto, where the specter of disease and starvation always looms; stories from several of the ghetto's inhabitants.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: In Nazi-occupied France, informants create an environment of paranoia and fear, yet some people offer resistance in ways big and small; revisiting the legacy of the French Resistance to experience life under the Nazi boot.
programme.sub-title: The Small Acts of the French Resistance

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Shifting one's attention across the English Channel, where Britain faces the Nazi war machine alone; tracing the war in London through the eyes of a Jewish child in the East End, a bureaucrat performing unglamorous duties and a young Oxford student.
programme.sub-title: A Child and a Pilot in the London Blitz

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: When the Nazis set up a siege of Leningrad in 1941, none of the city's inhabitants can envision the impact; finding out what daily life is like inside "the Ring" of besieged Leningrad through the eyes and diaries of three unforgettable women.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Prior to the war, Americans in the Philippines live in a "soldier's paradise"; this changes when the Japanese invade the country; seeing what life is like after the fall of the Philippines, from the Bataan Death March to an internment camp in Manila.
programme.sub-title: The Captured and Pursued in the Philippines

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Driven close to financial collapse by the French and Indian War, England turns for help to the colonies that had fought at its side; the new taxes, imposed without representation, outrage people who consider themselves fully English.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Britain's understanding of its ancient, although unwritten, style of government places it at odds with that of its colonists; the colonists see in John Locke's theories not a hypothetical thought experiment, but an argument for autonomy.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: What the typical British soldier and officers are like; knowing how the troops are organized and equipped; meeting the forces expected to maintain order in the increasingly rebellious colonies.
programme.sub-title: "A Soldier What's Fit for a Soldier"

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Tensions escalate and the first Continental Congress convenes; King George III finally heeds a request for reinforcements; nevertheless, the British sorely underestimate American militia and suffer a humiliating defeat at Lexington and Concord.
programme.sub-title: "How the British Regulars Fired and Fled"

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Benedict Arnold helps win a key victory at New York's Fort Ticonderoga; the Second Continental Congress authorizes a new army under George Washington, a soldier aware of the implications of the conflict; the risk of potentially rebellious slaves.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Whether rebel militia can stand up to British regulars; a brutal battle where the British pay dearly for their victory; Washington arrives to find disorganization and a reluctance to set aside regional differences in favor of a national army.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Ignoring the reconciliation implied by the colonies' Olive Branch Petition; the king and Parliament effectively declare war; on either side of the Atlantic, British leadership believes the many Americans still loyal to the Crown will bring victory.
programme.sub-title: The King, the Conqueror, and the Coward

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: An American plan to conquer Canada nearly succeeds and costs Britain half its regulars; even after the arrival of British reinforcements, American forces pull off the overland transport of critical artillery, captured at Fort Ticonderoga, to Boston.

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: Learning about the sectional controversies and clashes that ultimately set the stage for secession and war.

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: The presidential canvass of 1860 is the most important in U.S. history; it results in Abraham Lincoln's election as the first Republican to occupy the White House and brings sectional tensions to a head.

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: Beginning with South Carolina in December 1860, all of the Lower South states secede by the first week of February 1861; they send delegates to a convention in Montgomery, Alabama, that establishes the Confederate States of America.

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: From February through April 1861, the United States and the Confederacy eye each other warily and vie for the support of eight slave states; as various compromise proposals fall short, Fort Sumter in Charleston Harbor becomes a flashpoint.

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: Many think that the South is fated to lose; learning when the Confederate States of America came closest to winning; as fighting begins, each side has important advantages.

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: Learning whether the Confederacy has better generals and which side has the edge in strategic and political leadership; the attitudes of England and France; studying the side which marshals its resources and exploits its advantages more effectively.

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: Learning why the young men join the colors of the North or the South; understanding what makes them bear the war's awful dangers and hardships; uncovering what it is like to be a soldier in the ranks.

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: Following the Upper South's secession and the move of the Confederate capital to Richmond, Virginia, both sides gear up for war; learning the details of General Winfield Scott's Anaconda Plan and the factors that lead to the Battle of First Manassas.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: Exploring the significance of battlefields and the methods employed by soldiers in combat.
programme.sub-title: The Power of Place: The Civil War in Context

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: Marching from Washington, Irvin McDowell's Union forces encounter P. G. T. Beauregard's Confederate troops at Virginia's Bull Run.
programme.sub-title: Manassas: The First Battle of Bull Run

programme.title: The American Civil War
programme.desc: Stonewall Jackson fights in the Shenandoah Valley; Joseph E. Johnston attacks McClellan at Seven Pines or Fair Oaks; in the Seven Days' Battles, Robert E. Lee seizes the initiative and presses the Federals south to the James; Lee saves Richmond.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: In the Second Battle of Bull Run, lieutenants James Longstreet and Thomas Stonewall Jackson play a crucial role in securing victory for Robert E. Lee.
programme.sub-title: A Return to Manassas: The Second Battle of Bull Run

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: The diverse terrains hinder troop formations and make the soldiers vulnerable to attacks during the Antietam battle. This results in intense fighting and many casualties.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: The war photographers provide an up-close look at the devastation caused during the Antietam battle. Compassionate medics like Clara Barton go down in history as heroes.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: The politically driven decision to replace McClellan with Burnside leads the Union soldiers to their doom in Fredericksburg.

programme.title: The Great Tours: Civil War Battlefields
programme.desc: Victory comes at a heavy price for Robert E. Lee in the Battle of Chancellorsville after he employs some arguably high-risk battle strategies.

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: When the Germans begin their rapid invasions across Europe, many ordinary citizens are stunned; Dedee de Jongh, a 23-year-old nurse, builds an escape line through Belgium and France to rescue stranded British airmen; her courage and ingenuity.
programme.sub-title: Andrée de Jongh and the Resistance

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: In hindsight, it may appear inevitable that Winston Churchill takes command; at the time, it seems unthinkable that Neville Chamberlain steps down; how a few brave politicians orchestrate one of the most striking political transitions in history.
programme.sub-title: The Tory Rebels Who Helped Save England

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: As an Olympic athlete, Victor de Laveleye is not an ordinary man; there is no reason to think he comes up with one of the war's most popular symbols, helping to buoy spirits and wage psychological warfare; the story of the V for Victory campaign.
programme.sub-title: Victor de Laveleye and V for Victory

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: When the Germans invade the Netherlands and Norway, Adolf Hitler wants to secure the leadership of these nations; the wrenching decisions and harrowing escapes of Queen Wilhelmina and King Haakon; how these royal figures fight the war from Britain.
programme.sub-title: Wilhelmina and Haakon: Royalty Fight Back

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: The RAF's air battle to defend Britain from Germany in 1940; few people know that roughly 20 percent of the RAF is comprised of non-British pilots; witnessing the courage and successful maneuvers of Polish fighter pilots who save the day.
programme.sub-title: Polish Pilots and the Battle of Britain

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: It might seem impossible to find a politician willing to sabotage his own campaign; that is exactly what Wendell Willkie does in his 1940 run against President Roosevelt; why he goes against his own party and supports FDR's plans to help Britain.
programme.sub-title: Wendell Willkie: "A Godsend to This Country"

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: Charles Henry George Howard, the 20th Earl of Suffolk, is an Englishman who seems unlikely to be responsible for the future of the free world; how he smuggles French scientists to England; how he foils Nazi efforts to obtain a nuclear bomb.
programme.sub-title: The Earl of Suffolk and Heavy Water

programme.title: Unsung Heroes of World War II: Europe
programme.desc: For years, the history books suggest there are no women leaders of the Resistance in France; the story of Marie-Madeleine Fourcade blows this theory out of the water; meeting this extraordinary woman; how she leads a spy ring throughout France.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Examining the conflict from the bottom-up by exploring the people connected to the fighting; zeroing in on what war reveals about the human condition.

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Surveying the economic exploitation and repression that defines Vietnam in the 19th and early 20th centuries.
programme.sub-title: French Indochina and the Viet Minh

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Examining mid-century Vietnam from the First Indochina War to the October 1955 referendum.
programme.sub-title: Dien Bien Phu and Vietnam Divided, 1953-1959

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Explore the makings of war in Vietnam through five major players, starting with Vietnamese leaders Ho Chi Minh and Le Duan in the north and Ngo Dinh Diem in the south.
programme.sub-title: Five Leaders Who Defined the Vietnam War

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Examining why the northern Vietnamese government decided to wage guerilla war in the south, and how it's adversaries responded.
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Viet Cong, 1959-1962

programme.title: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: In 1963, South Vietnam careens toward crisis; exploring the ARVN's deficiencies from lackluster military commanders to political legitimacy.

programme.title: Raggedy Man
programme.desc: While World War II rages overseas, a divorced mother of two, Nita Longley (Sissy Spacek), struggles to makes ends meet as a telephone operator in small-town Texas. As the subject of disdainful gossip due to her divorce, Nita faces a lonely existence of ostracism, where only the unscrupulous approach her -- often with ill intent. When she befriends Teddy (Eric Roberts), a sailor on leave, her situation improves, but he's soon sent to war. Once again, Nita must face her plight alone.

programme.title: Continental Divide
programme.desc: Chicago reporter Ernie Souchak (John Belushi) is beaten up by double-dealing police officers after he writes about an unethical city councilman. Hoping to keep Ernie safe, his editor, Howard McDermott (Allen Goorwitz), tells him to head west. In Wyoming, Ernie strikes up a romance with bird scientist Nell Porter (Blair Brown), but as soon as he goes home, he's drawn back into city politics. With Nell about to discuss her research in Chicago, this might be the couple's last chance to reunite.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Heart and Souls
programme.desc: Harrison (Charles Grodin), Penny (Alfre Woodard), Julia (Kyra Sedgwick) and Milo (Tom Sizemore) die in 1959 when the bus they are riding crashes. The four continue as ghosts, guardians to the child born at the moment of their deaths. Baby Thomas grows up to be a businessman (Robert Downey Jr.) who has memories of his playmates, but assumes they are products of his youthful imagination. When the ghosts realize they need Thomas' help to move on, they decide to make an appearance once more.

programme.title: Cry Baby
programme.desc: A prim and proper schoolgirl goes against her mother's wishes when she dates a motorcycle-riding juvenile delinquent.

programme.title: The Cockeyed Cowboys of Calico County
programme.desc: In the Wild West, Charley (Dan Blocker), a blacksmith, is a nice man but not the smartest in his little town. And when his quest for a mail-order bride is fruitless, he's embarrassed and threatens to ditch. But since he's the only blacksmith around, the people decide to hatch a plan to keep Charley around. Eventually, they pay local saloon girl Sadie (Nanette Fabray) to pose as the missing bride. But complications ensue as Charley begins to fall in love with Sadie.

programme.title: Act of the Heart
programme.desc: Zealously devout Christian Martha (Geneviève Bujold) arrives in Montreal to assist widowed mother Johane (Monique Leyrac) with the care of her ailing young son, Russell (William Mitchell). Martha lives with a monastic simplicity, spending her free time singing with a church choir, despite being surrounded by wealthy people. Life becomes more interesting when she develops a crush on handsome priest Ferrier (Donald Sutherland) -- but a spiritual crisis pushes her to make a dangerous confession.

programme.title: Minnie and Moskowitz
programme.desc: Depressed and jaded after being dumped by her married boyfriend, aging beauty Minnie Moore (Gena Rowlands) wonders if she'll ever find love. After shaggy-haired parking lot attendant Seymour Moskowitz (Seymour Cassel) comes to her defense from an angry and rebuffed blind date, he falls hopelessly in love with her despite their myriad differences. Minnie reluctantly agrees to a date with Moskowitz, and, slowly but surely, an unlikely romance blossoms between the two.

programme.title: The Girl From Petrovka
programme.desc: A Moscow-based U.S. journalist (Hal Holbrook) falls in love with a ballerina (Goldie Hawn) being followed by the police.

programme.title: That Funny Feeling
programme.desc: A New York publisher (Bobby Darin) humors an actress/maid (Sandra Dee) who tries to pass off his apartment as her own.

programme.title: Same Time, Next Year
programme.desc: In 1951, at a small California inn, George (Alan Alda) and Doris (Ellen Burstyn) have an affair. Instead of writing it off as a one-night stand, the pair decide to meet at the inn every year for a romantic retreat, away from their respective spouses and families. In the decades that follow, both George and Doris face their own personal struggles and hardships, and together they develop a level of love and intimacy that exceeds the ones found in their own marriages.

In the decades that follow, both George and Doris face their own personal struggles and hardships, and together they develop a level of love and intimacy that exceeds the ones found in their own marriages.

programme.title: Heartbeeps
programme.desc: While at the repair factory, Val (Andy Kaufman), a robot valet, meets Aqua (Bernadette Peters), a fellow automaton who functions as a party hostess. Remarkably, the two robots discover that they are in love, and impulsively flee from their duties. Looking for a place where they can establish a home, Val and Aqua create their own mechanized child, but their happiness is short-lived, since a relentless enforcer robot has been programmed to apprehend them.

programme.title: The Return of the Musketeers
programme.desc: When ambitious Oliver Cromwell (Alan Howard) overthrows the king, Cardinal Mazarin (Philippe Noiret) enlists a down-and-out D'Artagnan (Michael York) to rally the Musketeers against him. Porthos (Frank Finlay) accepts at once, but Athos (Oliver Reed) and Aramis (Richard Chamberlain) are reluctant. Still, the three reunite, but they are soon torn apart by infighting. They get a chance at redemption when they are sent to England to save the life of King Charles I (Bill Paterson).

programme.title: Dudley Do-Right
programme.desc: Based on the cartoon, this live-action comedy follows the adventures of Dudley Do-Right (Brendan Fraser), an enthusiastic, if somewhat dim, Canadian Mountie. When Dudley's childhood crush, Nell Fenwick (Sarah Jessica Parker), returns to their hometown in the mountains, he is eager to spend time with her, but his attempts at courting her are foiled by the villainous Snidely Whiplash (Alfred Molina), who is up to his usual schemes. Can Dudley win Nell's heart and curtail Snidely's wicked ways?

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: As Wendy Darling (Rachel Hurd-Wood) recounts stories to her brothers, John (Harry Newell) and Michael (Freddie Popplewell), she is visited by Peter Pan (Jeremy Sumpter). Peter, a boy who magically never ages, invites Wendy and her brothers to Neverland, an island where he lives with the Lost Boys. Once there, however, Wendy and her brothers are kidnapped by Captain Hook (Jason Isaacs). Peter, with assistance from the fairy Tink (Ludivine Sagnier), must face Hook in order to rescue the Darlings.

programme.title: The Perfect Man
programme.desc: Every time Jean (Heather Locklear) goes through a bad breakup, she moves her two daughters elsewhere. Determined to make a home in New York, their latest destination, eldest daughter Holly (Hilary Duff) creates a fake online secret admirer for her mother, based on her friend's uncle. But as the "romance" develops, Holly encounters obstacles as her mom falls for the lie. Meanwhile, Holly has found her own love interest this time around in her cute classmate Adam (Ben Feldman).

programme.title: My Adventures with Santa
programme.desc: Instead of a joyous family gathering, the Nolans are spending this holiday apart. On a last minute shopping trip with Dad, the family enters an enchanted store only to discover a dazzling snow globe with magical powers.

programme.title: Heartbeeps

Remarkably, the two robots discover that they are in love, and impulsively flee from their duties. Looking for a place where they can establish a home, Val and Aqua create their own mechanized child, but their happiness is short-lived, since a relentless enforcer robot has been programmed to apprehend them.

Porthos (Frank Finlay) accepts at once, but Athos (Oliver Reed) and Aramis (Richard Chamberlain) are reluctant. Still, the three reunite, but they are soon torn apart by infighting. They get a chance at redemption when they are sent to England to save the life of King Charles I (Bill Paterson).

programme.title: Al son del mambo

programme.title: Mi héroe
programme.desc: Un escritor lleva a su esposa a la vieja casa de sus antepasados, donde son acechados por una serie de fantasmas.

programme.title: Espinas de una flor
programme.desc: Un joven tiene que partir y, cuando vuelve, su exnovia está casada con otro. Por esta razón, le reclama que su amor fue flor de un día.

programme.title: Los Invisibles
programme.desc: Un mago regresa a una tienda para recobrar una muñeca en la que ha escondido un diamante robado pero no la recupera.

programme.title: Conozco a los dos
programme.desc: Un hombre mujeriego se lleva a su hija a la capital para evitar que se case con un cantante, pero el joven los sigue.

programme.title: A ritmo de twist
programme.desc: Matusalén es encargado de la tienda de trajes de baño de su tío, junto a su amigo Beto. La competencia les envía a dos hermosas mujeres a espiarlos y robar las ideas y diseños del tío.

programme.title: El Barro Humano
programme.desc: Un hombre ha herido a su esposa y en el juicio se niega a defenderse, esto obliga a reconstruir los hechos con testigos.

programme.title: No me quieras tanto
programme.desc: Un hombre cumple una condena de cinco años y, cuando queda libre, jura vengarse del empresario que lo hizo encarcelar.

programme.title: ¡Grítenme piedras del campo!
programme.desc: Un ranchero se enamora de la joven profesora que llega al pueblo y hace cualquier cosa por reconstruir la vieja escuela.

programme.title: Cada voz lleva su angustia
programme.desc: Unas personas hacen de todo en su lucha por sobrevivir en una tierra árida.

programme.title: El sombrero de tres picos
programme.desc: Un hombre hace versos para enamorar a mujeres, su esposa se ofende y piensa hacer exactamente lo mismo.

programme.title: México de mis recuerdos
programme.desc: Una hermosa joven trata conquistar el amor de un hombre, y busca alcanzar la fama como cantante de ópera.

programme.title: Al diablo las mujeres
programme.desc: Una joven es nombrada presidenta municipal y exige encarcelar a sus primos, que son obligados a barrer las calles.

programme.title: Tu vida entre mis manos
programme.desc: Un médico salva a una mujer herida, y la hace su amante para que no lo delate a la policía, luego se da a la bebida.

programme.title: Los viejos somos así
programme.desc: Una joven presta dinero de su trabajo a su novio y este no se lo paga, pero un anciano la ayuda a cambio de amor.

programme.title: Juan Charrasqueado
programme.desc: Un ranchero regresa a su pueblo, les gana en un juego de cartas a unos jugadores profesionales y escapa con su novia.

programme.title: De Tal Palo Tal Astilla
programme.desc: Dos recién nacidos son confundidos al nacer y los padres se sienten mutuamente traicionados hasta que todo se aclara.

programme.title: La Bruja
programme.desc: Una mujer fea toma un brebaje que la vuelve hermosa temporalmente, pero todo el que la vea en estado de fealdad, morirá.

programme.title: Santo contra el doctor Muerte

programme.title: Guantanamera

programme.title: Los malvados
programme.desc: Un anciano es defendido por tres bandidos de unos asaltantes, y cuando muere, les pide que cuiden de su joven nieta.

programme.desc: Una bailarina huye a otro país y un hombre que se enamora de ella mata a todos los hombres que se le acercan.

programme.title: Audaz y Bravero

programme.title: On Patrol: Live
programme.desc: "On Patrol: Live" follows police officers and sheriff's deputies from diverse agencies in different cities across the country for three hours. Program hosts Dan Abrams, Deputy Sheriff Curtis Wilson, and Captain Tom Rizzo provide minute-by-minute perspective and analysis from a central studio location during footage. Local residents from the communities of featured departments are given the opportunity to have a firsthand experience during ride-alongs with officers on live nights.

programme.title: Cops Reloaded
programme.desc: "Cops" has been producing new episodes for more than 20 years, and with daily repeats of the iconic series entering their second decade on the air, producers felt it was time for a change to freshen things up, which is how the idea for "Cops Reloaded" was born. This entry in the long-running franchise takes footage from previous episodes and re-edits it to produce new episodes. Some of the program's wildest criminals, most memorable car chases, and craziest moments are featured on "Reloaded."

Once they fell in love, Melinda molded herself into everything he wanted her to be. She sacrificed for him, worked to support his grandiose dreams, and put up with him for better or for worse. She takes an internship at a matchmaking firm for millionaires and meets Harley (Robbie Jones), a charismatic client who makes no effort to hide his attraction to Judith. Judith succumbs to his charms, placing her marriage in jeopardy.

When his drug-dealing ex-wife wins custody of the girls in court, he enlists the help of Julia (Gabrielle Union), a successful attorney, to get the girls back. Romance unexpectedly blooms between the pair, but the couple must come to terms with their very different lives and find a way to keep Monty's family together.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds

Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The Wilding
programme.desc: A family tries to start over following a daughter's release from a mental health institution.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde
programme.desc: Policemen Slim (Bud Abbott) and Tubby (Lou Costello) go to London and meet a doctor (Boris Karloff) and his evil alter ego.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein
programme.desc: In the first of Bud Abbott and Lou Costello's horror vehicles for Universal Pictures, the inimitable comic duo star as railway baggage handlers in northern Florida. When a pair of crates belonging to a house of horrors museum are mishandled by Wilbur (Lou Costello), the museum's director, Mr. MacDougal (Frank Ferguson), demands that they deliver them personally so that they can be inspected for insurance purposes, but Lou's friend Chick (Bud Abbott) has grave suspicions.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Invisible Man
programme.desc: Two detective-school graduates (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) help a framed boxer who can make himself disappear.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Killer, Boris Karloff
programme.desc: A hotel detective (Bud Abbott) and bellhop (Lou Costello) find dead bodies and a fake swami (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy
programme.desc: Two guys (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) stuck in Egypt follow a medallion to the crypt of Kharis.

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: The Black Cat
programme.desc: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: A boy (Scott Sealey) upset by his parents' divorce must also tell the sheriff his father (Kerwin Mathews) is a werewolf.

programme.title: Bride of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After recovering from injuries sustained in the mob attack upon himself and his creation, Dr. Frankenstein (Colin Clive) falls under the control of his former mentor, Dr. Pretorius (Ernest Thesiger), who insists the now-chastened doctor resume his experiments in creating new life. Meanwhile, the Monster (Boris Karloff) remains on the run from those who wish to destroy him without understanding that his intentions are generally good despite his lack of socialization and self-control.

programme.title: The Brides of Dracula
programme.desc: Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt).

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parents (James Brolin) is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett (John Marley), is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren (Kathleen Lloyd), are endangered.

programme.title: Creature From the Black Lagoon
programme.desc: Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

programme.title: The Creature Walks Among Us
programme.desc: Scientists (Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason) capture the creature from the black lagoon and turn him into an air breather.

programme.title: Curse of the Undead
programme.desc: A cow-town preacher (Eric Fleming) shoots a custom bullet at a vampire gunfighter (Michael Pate) in the Old West.

programme.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
programme.desc: A man with brutal and macabre origins, Leon Corledo (Oliver Reed) was raised in the home of Don Alfredo Corledo (Clifford Evans), his kind and loving adopted father. When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.

programme.title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
programme.desc: A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

programme.title: The Deadly Mantis
programme.desc: A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel (Albert Dekker) invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

programme.title: Dracula's Daughter
programme.desc: Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

programme.title: House of Horrors
programme.desc: An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

programme.title: Island of Lost Souls
programme.desc: In this adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel "The Island of Doctor Moreau," Edward Parker (Richard Arlen) is shipwrecked on a remote island presided over by the mysterious Dr. Moreau (Charles Laughton). Edward discovers his host is conducting genetic experiments, and presiding over a race of half-human, half-animal hybrids, including the alluring Panther Woman and the sage Sayer of the Law (Bela Lugosi). The island has become its own society, with Moreau as its god.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades

programme.title: Southpaw
programme.desc: Billy "The Great" Hope (Jake Gyllenhaal), the reigning junior middleweight boxing champion, has an impressive career, a loving wife and daughter, and a lavish lifestyle. However, when tragedy strikes, Billy hits rock bottom, losing his family, his house and his manager. He soon finds an unlikely savior in Tick Willis (Forest Whitaker), a former fighter who trains the city's toughest amateur boxers. With his future on the line, Hope fights to reclaim the trust of those he loves the most.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: An estranged family finds redemption in the unlikeliest of places: the MMA ring. Tommy (Tom Hardy), an ex-Marine with a tragic past, returns home and enlists his father (Nick Nolte), a recovering alcoholic and former wrestling coach, to train him for "Sparta," the biggest MMA tournament ever held. But when Tommy's underdog brother, Brendan (Joel Edgerton), fights his way into the tournament, the two brothers must finally confront each other and the forces that pulled them apart.

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa.

programme.title: Stronger
programme.desc: Jeff Bauman loses both of his legs when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon on April 15, 2013. After regaining consciousness in the hospital, Jeff is able to help law enforcement identify one of the suspects, but his own battle is just beginning. With unwavering support from his family and girlfriend, Bauman embarks on a long and heroic journey to physical and emotional rehabilitation.

programme.title: Vámonos para la feria

programme.desc: Los dos hijos de un campesino vuelven de trabajar como braceros y él les reprocha que no le ayuden en el campo.

programme.desc: Un joven es elegido para tocar música cubana en una película y durante la filmación descubre sus propios talentos.

programme.desc: Un detective trabaja encubierto para atrapar a un narcotraficante que se dedica a lavar dinero.
